select m.merchant_id as merchantId, m.account_id as accountId, m.merchant_name as merchantName, m.category_id as categoryId, m.logo as logo, m.contact_name as contactName, m.contact_phone as contactPhone, m.license_files as licenseFiles, m.open_status as openStatus, m.status as status, m.del_flag as delFlag, m.create_time as createTime, m.update_time as updateTime, m.remark as remark from merchant m
mapper.select: select m.merchant_id as merchantId, m.account_id as accountId, a.nick_name as accountNickName, a.mobile as accountMobile, m.merchant_name as merchantName, m.category_id as categoryId, mc.category_name as categoryName, m.logo as logo, m.contact_name as contactName, m.contact_phone as contactPhone, m.license_files as licenseFiles, m.open_status as openStatus, m.status as status, m.del_flag as delFlag, m.create_time as createTime, m.update_time as updateTime, m.remark as remark from merchant m left join account a on m.account_id = a.account_id and a.del_flag = 0 left join merchant_category mc on m.category_id = mc.category_id and mc.del_flag = 0 where m.del_flag = 0 and m.merchant_id = #{merchantId} limit 1
